The manual CLI smoke test was blocked by the sandbox (shell command with export/chaining needs approval I can't get in this session), but `npm test` already passed all 12 tests, which fully exercises the new date-parsing logic (`resolveDoneDay`, `done` with `dateArg`).

Summary of changes:
- `src/streak.js`: added `resolveDoneDay(dateArg, today)` — resolves `undefined` → today, `'yesterday'` → today−1 day, or a literal `YYYY-MM-DD` string.
- `src/commands.js`: `done(name, dateArg, today)` now uses `resolveDoneDay` instead of always marking `today`.
- `src/cli.js`: `done` command detects a trailing `yesterday` or `YYYY-MM-DD` token in argv and passes it through as `dateArg`; otherwise behaves as before.
- Updated `test/commands.test.js` (existing calls now pass `today` as the 3rd arg, not 2nd) and added tests for `yesterday` and explicit-date cases in both `commands.test.js` and `streak.test.js`.

One adjacent note, not implemented: a literal `today` keyword (e.g. `habit done read today`) isn't special-cased — it'd currently be swallowed into the habit name unless you want that added too.
